title: Filtered colimits of abelian sheaves on a site are exact
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site and $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)$ its category of abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Then every small diagram in $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)$ has a colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] (the sheafification of the sectionwise colimit), and filtered colimits are exact: for a small filtered category $\Lambda$ and a diagram $0\to\mathcal F_\lambda\to\mathcal G_\lambda\to\mathcal H_\lambda\to0$ of short exact sequences in $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)$ indexed by $\Lambda$, the sequence $0\to\varinjlim\mathcal F_\lambda\to\varinjlim\mathcal G_\lambda\to\varinjlim\mathcal H_\lambda\to0$ is exact. (General-site version of the exactness clause of [lem-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves-grothendieck].)
